name: VC Analyst
description: An AI deal-flow CRM for a venture team. Founder intros arrive by email, become deals, get scored against the fund's thesis, and wait for a partner to decide. One shared board, one thesis, visible to everyone in the pod.

gmail_intake_account.description: Gmail account the gmail-intake automation reads founder intros from. Leave it out on a first import; ./wire-gmail.sh sets it once somebody has connected Gmail.

vc_analyst_slug.description: Public URL slug for the app (unique platform-wide; a suffix is added on collision)
